resolved_memoryos_configuration_defect.overlay_action: The adapter redirects only Updater._get_embedding_for_page to the already configured mid_term_memory embedding name and kwargs. No vector function, normalization, threshold, capacity, prompt, or retrieval rule changes.
resolved_memoryos_configuration_defect.claim_boundary: This is a reproducibility configuration-plumbing overlay and must be reported; it is not an AgentEnhance method contribution.

resolved_memgas_observability.model_loading: Module-local AutoModel and AutoTokenizer proxies accept only facebook/contriever and load the frozen local path with local_files_only=True.

resolved_memgas_observability.claim_boundary: Both overlays are reproducibility/observability controls and must not be described as algorithmic changes.
